326:596.en: 「Not bad! But it's not over yet!!」

326:734.en: 「The weak have no place in battle!!」

326:811.en: 「Is that all? You're no match for me!」

326:1241.en: 「Now show me what you can do!」

326:1483.en: 「Your guard was too lax! Your fault!」

326:1591.en: 「$$デュオ$$, I'll take it from here!」

326:1618.en: 「$$トロワ$$! I'll take that one down!」

326:1647.en: 「$$カトル$$, I'll take it from here!」

326:1989.en: 「Don't take the field if that's all!」

326:2259.en: 「Fine! Come at me with all you have!」

326:2294.en: 「Ngh!\nNow's your one shot to beat me!」

326:2498.en: 「Now I can give up fighting too!\nFarewell, $$トレーズ$$.」

326:2783.en: 「I don't need you ordering me around!」

326:3249.en: 「Grr, I still have much to learn...!」

326:3394.en: 「Time to show you how I fight...!」

326:3427.en: 「I'm $$張五飛$$! I won't run or hide!」

326:3505.en: 「$$ナタク$$, guide me to the right path!」

326:3740.en: 「I'll just do my best right now...!」

326:3883.en: 「I'll land a direct hit, for sure!」

326:3942.en: 「I won't let you in so easily...!」

326:4206.en: 「I'm $$張五飛$$, the man who beat you!」

326:4282.en: 「I'll keep at it until you go down!」

326:4348.en: 「Why not state your aim and identity!」

326:4457.en: 「I won't bow to a mere calamity!」

326:4572.en: 「Don't worry. I'll save you for sure.」

326:4755.en: 「A worthy opponent!\nLet's fight fair and square!」

326:4862.en: 「You're too big to turn on a dime!」

326:5068.en: 「$$フロンタル$$!\nIf you're right, then defeat me!」

326:5129.en: 「$$ハマーン$$! As I thought,\nyou can't shed your naivety either!」

326:5248.en: 「Beings who only spread war\nare not needed in space!」

326:5361.en: 「My enemy is all the evil\nthat brings war to the world!」

326:5410.en: 「You fight for nothing but your ego!」

326:5496.en: 「Invaders, $$サイデリアル$$!\nYou are my enemy!」

326:5545.en: 「You who brought war to Earth\nare the true evil!」

326:5594.en: 「Anyone who uses such power in battle\nis my enemy!」

326:5645.en: 「The evil power of the $$スフィア$$...!\nI can't allow it!」

326:5700.en: 「Even if it's $$スフィア$$ power,\nmy justice won't be shattered!」

326:5792.en: 「I've never seen an enemy look\nthis foul and huge!」

326:5843.en: 「Now, so-called emissary of God...!\nShow me true justice!」

326:5904.en: 「Pay the price of betrayal\nwith your body, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

326:6027.en: 「You who toady to the strong\nare no enemy of mine!」

326:6078.en: 「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$, prepare yourself!」

326:6111.en: 「$$アサキム$$!\nI'll free you from that suffering!」

326:6166.en: 「What humanity needs isn't salvation!\nIt's the fight of living!」

326:6227.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! You are in no way\njustice! An enemy to be defeated!」

326:6294.en: 「So the time to use this has come...!」

326:6563.en: 「Fail to finish me, and this happens!」

326:6654.en: 「I make a point of repaying debts!」

326:6851.en: 「I've seen what you can do, $$ゼクス$$.」

326:6926.en: 「Leave the real combat to me, $$ゼロ$$!」

326:6990.en: 「Fall back if you want to live!」

326:7344.en: 「I'll do my part without being told.」

326:7585.en: 「For now, I bide my time...\nBut I'll repay this soon...!」

alternatives: You think that can hurt me?!
As if that could hurt me!

326:7899.en: 「As if that attack would work on me!」

326:8050.en: 「Why fight?\nAgainst an enemy you can't beat...!」

326:8099.en: 「Is that all! You're no match for me!」

326:8231.en: 「I'm not one to yield to pain!」

326:8303.en: 「You can't beat me down\nwith something like this!」

326:8373.en: 「Ngh...!\nThe next move may decide the match!」

326:8467.en: 「With that much power,\nwhy do you misuse it!」

326:8520.en: 「Body and mech still move! I can fight!」

326:8563.en: 「Defeat them before my life ends...!\nThat's all!」

326:8653.en: 「$$ナタク$$, we have to be strong...!」

326:8815.en: 「A greater evil brings the player back! I'll be that evil!」
